name: Wayfinder Tiles
summary: A tall stepped minaret leads into a tiled mosque, with a path bending out through its central doorway.
why: The doorway and dome share x60. The six-unit path begins inside the true doorway opening, crosses the y69 foundation, then turns through exact right-angle contacts. Architecture and path form a single connected silhouette.
risk: The path becomes a simple hooked foundation at 24px; the tall minaret remains the main identifier.
sub1: The added element grows out of the mosque
sub2: A strong upright balanced by a low prayer hall
reasonToChoose: You want direction and prayer expressed as one connected geometric mark.
